name: Jonathan Polach Photography
description: Unhurried, warm photographs of the people and moments that matter. Based wherever your day is.

contact.intro: Tell me a little about your plans and I will reply within a couple of days.

home.title: Days as they were
home.intro: I photograph weddings and celebrations the way they actually feel: unhurried, warm, and a little bit wild. No stiff poses, just the people you love.

facts.label: of coverage on a full day

moments.title: Getting ready
moments.text: Quiet, close, and often the funniest hour of the day.

moments.title: First look
moments.text: Just the two of you before everyone arrives.

moments.title: The ceremony
moments.text: I stay at the edges and let it happen.

moments.title: Family and friends
moments.text: A handful of group photos, done quickly so you can get to the party.

moments.title: Golden hour
moments.text: Ten unhurried minutes with the best light of the day.

moments.title: Dinner and toasts
moments.text: The speeches, the faces in the crowd, the laughter.

moments.title: First dance
moments.text: The moment everyone stops and watches.

moments.title: The dance floor
moments.text: Loose, loud and full of joy.

testimonial.quote: We forgot he was even there, and somehow he caught every moment we would have missed.
